KISWAHILI — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. pana
   C. nene
   D. zito

2. When practising Sarufi 1.4.1 Nomino, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Sarufi 1.4.1 Nomino.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Sarufi 1.4.1 Nomino.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Sarufi 1.4.1 Nomino.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sarufi 1.4.1 Nomino.

3. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

4. When practising Kusoma 1.2.1 Kusoma kwa Ufahamu, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Kuandika 1.3.1 Insha ya Wasifu.

6. When practising Maamkuzi na Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maamkuzi na Maagano.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Maamkuzi na Maagano.

7. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

8. When practising Kusikiliza na Kuzungumza 1.1.1 Matamshi Bora Sauti, which approach is best? (1 mark)

----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Kuandika 10.3.1 Insha ya Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
